hero.description: Write test scenarios in natural language. Heimdall transforms them into precise, executable tests for Android and Web — all from one desktop app. Start your 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

about.description: Eliminate context switching. Heimdall bridges element inspection, dynamic execution, and diagnostic reporting into a single, cohesive desktop workflow.
about.list_item1: Single executable, zero background daemons required
about.list_item2: Deterministic execution with live frame-by-frame telemetry
about.list_item3: Self-healing selectors powered by local heuristic models
about.card1_desc: Seamlessly toggle between Android instrumentation and standard WebDriver sessions without altering your test definitions.
about.card2_desc: Express test actions in declarative, human-readable directives. Zero fragile boilerplate code or flaky selector spaghetti.
about.card3_desc: Auto-capture step-level screenshot diffs, CPU/RAM telemetry, and device crash traces bundled into an immutable audit report.

features.description: Heimdall Desktop brings enterprise-grade QA features into an intuitive, single-window workflow.
features.item1_desc: Inspect Android and Web UI elements instantly. Click any element on screen and Heimdall generates the selector code automatically — no manual ID hunting.
features.item2_desc: Watch test execution line by line in real-time. Mirror your Android device via Scrcpy or preview Web sessions through WebSocket — all in one pane.
features.item3_desc: Organize all scenarios in a clean, readable hierarchy. Built-in multi-tab Script Editor with IDE-like experience and auto-save.
features.item4_desc: Connect physical devices or spin up AVDs directly from the app. Monitor battery, OS version, and system logs in real-time from a single dashboard.
features.item5_desc: Host Telemetry auto-monitors CPU, RAM, and disk usage, alerting you before critical thresholds are hit — so your test machine never chokes.
features.item6_desc: Command Center Dashboard shows test health at a glance. Screenshots at every step, success metrics, and timeline replay — all auto-generated.

gallery.description: A second screen that earns its place. Design focused on clarity and density.

visual_intel.description: Every utility engineered for speed, accuracy, and minimum overhead — right at your fingertips.
visual_intel.item1_desc: Deconstruct complex Android view hierarchies or web shadow DOMs in milliseconds. Single-click element capture outputs robust, resilient test locators.
visual_intel.item2_desc: Attach physical ADB targets or launch headless AVDs without leaving the workspace. Real-time battery, thermal, and logcat stream monitoring.
visual_intel.item3_desc: Proactive CPU, RAM, and disk IO tracking prevents test run throttling and host crashes before long-running regression sweeps begin.
visual_intel.item4_desc: Ultra-low latency Scrcpy and WebSocket frame streams allow direct manual intervention and gesture recording directly inside the runner viewport.
visual_intel.item5_desc: Intelligent polling automatically handles async network requests and dynamic UI render delays without artificial sleep timeouts.
visual_intel.item6_desc: Replay failure sequences frame-by-frame with synchronized console logs, DOM snapshots, and network payload inspections.

docs_section.title: Professional Experience, Without the Hassle
docs_section.description: From device management to execution monitoring, everything is organized to support your productivity.
docs_section.card1_desc: No more guessing what happens on the device screen. With Floating Live Preview and Interactive Mirroring, you can see execution in real time.
docs_section.card2_desc: Goodbye to cluttered text files. Our Test Management System (TMS) organizes all your scenarios in an easy-to-read hierarchy.

faq.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions about Heimdall.
faq.a1: Heimdall is an AI-Powered QA Automation tool designed to solve the fatigue of manual regression testing. With Heimdall, you can perform end-to-end testing for Android and Web applications automatically.
faq.a2: Yes! Heimdall offers a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start. After the trial, you can choose a plan that fits your team's needs.
faq.a3: Heimdall supports various programming languages and platforms through integration with Android UI Automator for Android and Selenium WebDriver for Web testing.
faq.a4: You can install Heimdall by following the installation guide on our documentation page. The process is simple and only requires a few steps.
faq.q5: Does Heimdall require coding for basic usage?
faq.a5: No! Heimdall is designed to be used with natural human language. You only need to write scenarios in easy-to-understand language, and Heimdall will convert them into test code.
faq.a6: Yes! Heimdall comes with a user-friendly interface and complete documentation. Even beginners can use Heimdall in minutes.
faq.a7: Yes, Heimdall supports integration with various CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and more for automated testing in pipelines.
faq.a8: Heimdall offers three plans. Starter at Rp 100,000/month: single device support, editor & inspector, 7-day history. Pro at Rp 250,000/month: unlocks all completed SPECs plus multi-browser batch and up to 5 seats. Enterprise with custom pricing: Auto-Healing, Gesture Recorder, Multi-Device Monitoring, On-Premise, SSO/RBAC, and 24/7 SLA support. All plans include a 14-day free trial.
faq.a9: You can access our complete documentation, view usage examples on GitHub, or contact our team through the contact page for further questions.
